metadata.title: Cybersecurity stocks drop, as AI fears are on the back burner - MarketWatch

content.text:
1 hour ago
Cybersecurity stocks drop, as AI fears are on the back burner
Shares of cybersecurity companies are falling, as time has soothed some of the AI fears that triggered the previous session's surge in the group.
The First Trust Nasdaq Cybersecurity ETF was down 1% in premarket trading, after running up 6% on Monday. CrowdStrike's stock was losing 1.8%, after powering 13.9% higher Monday to close at a record high.
Palo Alto Networks shares, which surged 13.1% on Monday, were shedding 1.5% in Tuesday's premarket.
